arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Generate Fury: {/c}{c_resource}{SF_17}{/c} per enemy hit
{c_label}Cooldown: {/c}{c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}Rush forward and push enemies before swinging your weapon, dealing {c_number}{payload:SWING}{/c} damage and Knocking Back enemies.
Charge forward and push enemies with you.
{c_important}Charge{/c} gains {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} Charges, and all of its Charges are refreshed on Cooldown.
{c_important}Charge{/c} Summons {c_number}[SF_11]{/c} Ancients to {c_important}Charge{/c} with you and swing for {c_number}{payload:UB_SWING_ANCIENT}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Charge{/c} now deals Fire damage.

Instead of swinging your weapon, colliding with enemies deals {c_number}{payload:UC_PAYLOAD_NO_PUSH}{/c} Fire damage and Stuns them for {c_number}{buffDuration:UC_STUN}{/c} seconds. Additionally, you leave a burning trail that inflicts {c_number}{payload:UC_BURNING_TRAIL_TOOLTIP}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Charge{/c} deals up to {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage based on distance traveled.
{c_important}Charge's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} second for each enemy it hit, up to {c_number}{SF_30}{/c}.
{c_important}Charge{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage per enemy pushed, up to {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|x%|]{/c}.
